what: H9 faithful state-input LeWM: official predictor/Embedder/BatchNorm-MLP modules, official loss (pred MSE + 0.09*SIGReg on the same embedding), 5-step action blocks, official CEMSolver (300/30/30, N(0,1) in standardised action space); only the ViT is replaced by an MLP state encoder (12.69M params). Trained on the official PushT state data; evaluated with h10_expert_replay.py in OUR env loop (PushTEnv + _set_env_state + check_success), 48 held-out episodes, goal offset 25, budget 50 (2 plans), any-time success. Official pixel weights in the same loop: 44/50 = 88%.
